verses.t: At one time the Buddha was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. At that time the monks from the group of six ate shaking their hands. … One should not eat shaking one’s hand. If a monk, out of disrespect, eats shaking his hand, he commits an offense of wrong conduct. if it is unintentional; if he is not mindful; if he does not know; if he is sick; if he shakes his hand to discard trash; if there is an emergency; if he is insane; if he is the first offender. The seventh training rule is finished.
“‘I will not eat shaking my hand,’ this is how you should train.”
